items.jp: 前に行ってください。

translation.pt-BR: Por favor, vá em frente.
translation.en: Move along, please.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: this て is what turns 行く into 行って; it is what connects to ください to form the request 〜てください.

items.jp: 知っておくべきだよ。

translation.pt-BR: Você deveria saber disso, viu.
translation.en: You should know it.

items.label: conjunctive particle て
items.explanation: Links 知る to the auxiliary おく, forming the construction 〜ておく; without it the two verbs would not chain together.

items.jp: 新しい上着を着ている。

translation.pt-BR: Ele está usando um casaco novo.
translation.en: He's wearing a new coat.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 着る to the auxiliary いる, forming 〜ている (continuous state). It is this structure that gives the sense of 'is wearing' rather than just 'wears'.

items.jp: 新しい月もでてきました。

translation.pt-BR: Uma lua nova também apareceu.
translation.en: A new moon was coming up.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 出る to the auxiliary verb くる, forming 〜てくる. Without this て the two verbs could not chain together.

items.jp: 食事はオーブンのなかにおいてあります。

translation.pt-BR: A comida está guardada dentro do forno.
translation.en: I have left you your dinner in the oven.

items.label: conjunctive particle (te-form)
items.explanation: て links おく to the auxiliary ある, forming おいてある ('is left/kept').

items.jp: 乗ってください。

translation.pt-BR: Por favor, entre (no veículo).
translation.en: Please get in.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 乗る to ください, forming the polite request 〜てください.

items.jp: 少し休ませてください。

translation.pt-BR: Me deixa descansar um pouco.
translation.en: I want to take a rest.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: links the causative verb 休ませ to the auxiliary ください, forming the request ～てください.

items.jp: 少しステレオの音を小さくしてください。

translation.pt-BR: Abaixa um pouco o volume do som, por favor.
translation.en: Would you turn down the stereo a little?

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the verb して to ください, forming the polite request 〜てください ('please do...').

items.jp: 小鳥たちが森の中でさえずっていた。

translation.pt-BR: Os passarinhos estavam cantando dentro da floresta.
translation.en: The birds were singing in the forest.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the main verb to the auxiliary いる, forming the continuous construction 〜ている/〜ていた.
tokens: head of the place phrase (森の中 = the interior of the forest)

items.jp: 小さな子どもでもその名前を知っている。

translation.pt-BR: Até uma criancinha sabe esse nome.
translation.en: Even a little child knows its name.

items.label: connective particle of the te-form
items.explanation: て links 知る to the auxiliary いる, forming 知っている. By itself it translates as nothing; it is the grammatical connector that enables the 〜ている structure.

items.jp: 書いてくださいますか。

translation.pt-BR: Você poderia escrever isso, por favor?
translation.en: Could you write it down, please?

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: this て links 書く to くださいます; it is the link that creates the polite request 〜てくださいます.

items.jp: 春はまもなくやってくる。

translation.pt-BR: A primavera chegará em breve.
translation.en: Spring will be here before long.

items.label: connective particle (-te form)
items.explanation: て links やる to the auxiliary くる, forming やってくる ("come arriving").

items.jp: 出るか入るかどちらかにしてください。

translation.pt-BR: Decida-se: ou sai, ou entra.
translation.en: Either go out or come in.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: this て turns する into して and connects to ください, creating the request してください ('please decide').

items.jp: 出かける前に、ドアにかぎをかけてください。

translation.pt-BR: Por favor, tranque a porta antes de sair.
translation.en: Please lock the door before you go out.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: this て turns かける into かけて and connects to ください, forming the request かけてください ('please lock it').

items.jp: 手をきれいにしておかなければならない。

translation.pt-BR: Temos que manter as mãos limpas.
translation.en: We must keep our hands clean.

items.label: conjunctive particle (te-form)
items.explanation: て links する to the auxiliary verb おく, forming しておく ('to leave done / to keep in a state'), a combination of verb + aspectual verb.

items.jp: 試してみる。

translation.pt-BR: Vou tentar.
translation.en: I try.

items.label: connective particle (te-form)
items.explanation: Connects 試す to the auxiliary みる, forming 試してみる ('to try out/attempt'). Without this て the two verbs would not link.

items.jp: 時間があったら来てください。

translation.pt-BR: Por favor, venha aqui se tiver tempo.
translation.en: Please come over if you have time.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: this て turns 来る into 来て and connects to ください, forming the request 〜てください ('please come').

items.jp: 私は六時に起きることにしている。

translation.pt-BR: Faço questão de acordar às seis.
translation.en: I make it a rule to get up at six.

translation.pt-BR: Eu tenho o hábito de correr toda manhã.
translation.en: I make it a rule to jog every morning.

items.explanation: て links し to the auxiliary いる, forming している (aspect of a maintained habit).

translation.pt-BR: Nós já teremos ido embora antes de você chegar, viu.
translation.en: We'll be leaving before you get here.

items.label: conjunctive particle (て-form)
items.explanation: て connects 行く to しまう, forming 〜てしまう.

items.jp: 私は父だけでなくむすこも知っている。

translation.pt-BR: Eu conheço não só o pai, mas também o filho.
translation.en: I know not only the father, but also the son.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 知っ to いる to form 知っている, expressing the state of 'knowing'. Without it, いる could not attach to the verb.
tokens: negation auxiliary (part of だけでなく)

items.jp: 私は父にその映画を見てほしい。

translation.pt-BR: Eu quero que meu pai assista a esse filme.
translation.en: I want my father to see the movie.

items.label: conjunctive (て-form)
items.explanation: て links 見る to ほしい, forming the pattern てほしい.
tokens: desiderative adjective governing てほしい

items.jp: 私は朝早く起きることにしている。

translation.pt-BR: Faço questão de acordar cedo de manhã.
translation.en: I make it a rule to get up early in the morning.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links し (する) to いる to form している (habitual state).
tokens: formal noun that nominalizes the preceding clause
verb of the ことにしている pattern

items.jp: 私は早く起きることにしている。

translation.pt-BR: Faço questão de acordar cedo.
translation.en: I make it a rule to get up early.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links し (する) to いる to form している, giving the sense of a continuous state (maintained habit).
tokens: formal noun that nominalizes the preceding clause
verb of the ことにしている pattern

items.jp: 私は自転車も持っていない、まして車などとんでもない。

translation.pt-BR: Eu não tenho nem bicicleta, quanto mais carro.
translation.en: I don't have a bicycle, let alone a car.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 持つ to いる, forming the structure 〜ている (state of possessing).
tokens: element of とんでもない

items.jp: 私は今夜話すことになっている。

translation.pt-BR: Está combinado que eu vou falar hoje à noite.
translation.en: I am due to speak tonight.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links なっ (なる) to いる to form なっている (already established/agreed-upon state).
tokens: formal noun that nominalizes the preceding clause
verb of the ことになっている pattern

items.jp: 手紙を書いているところです。

translation.pt-BR: Estou bem no meio de escrever uma carta.
translation.en: I am writing a letter.

items.label: 〜て connector linking the verb to the auxiliary いる
items.explanation: This て puts 書く in the form 書いて to attach いる, forming the progressive 書いている ('to be writing'), the basis of the pattern 〜ているところ.
tokens: formal noun (head of 〜ているところ)

items.jp: 私はまるで何でも知っているかのように話す。

translation.pt-BR: Eu falo como se soubesse de tudo.
translation.en: I talk as if I knew everything.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 知っ to いる, forming the stative aspect 知っている ('to know').
tokens: adverb (announces the irrealis comparison, paired with 〜のように)

items.jp: 私はそこで３ヶ月間働いています。

translation.pt-BR: Eu trabalho lá há três meses.
translation.en: I've been working there for three months.

items.label: conjunctive of the te-form
items.explanation: て links 働く to いる, forming 働いている, the construction that expresses a continuous/ongoing action.

items.jp: 私はすぐに帰ってくる。

translation.pt-BR: Eu já volto.
translation.en: I'll come back soon.

items.label: connective particle て
items.explanation: Joins 帰る to the auxiliary くる in the construction 〜てくる.

translation.pt-BR: Faço questão de acordar às seis.
translation.en: I make it a rule to get up at six.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links し (する) to いる to form している (habitual state).
tokens: formal noun that nominalizes the preceding clause
verb of the ことにしている pattern

items.jp: 私は５千円だけしか持っていません。

translation.pt-BR: Eu só tenho cinco mil ienes.
translation.en: I have only five thousand yen.

items.label: て-form connective
items.explanation: て links 持つ to いる to form the continuous aspect 持っている (the state of having).

items.jp: 私にそれをさせてください。

translation.pt-BR: Deixe-me fazer isso, por favor.
translation.en: Let me do it.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the causative させ to ください, forming the request させてください ('please let me do that').

items.jp: 私たちは明日７時に会うことになっている。

translation.pt-BR: Está combinado que a gente vai se encontrar amanhã às sete.
translation.en: We are to meet at seven tomorrow.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て joins なる to いる to form the continuous-state structure ～ている (なっている).
tokens: auxiliary verb (part of ことになっている)

items.jp: 教えてくれるか？

translation.pt-BR: Você me ensina?
translation.en: Can you teach me?

items.label: connective particle て (links the verb to the auxiliary)
items.explanation: The て links 教える to the auxiliary くれる, setting up 〜てくれる, which marks a favor done toward the speaker.

items.jp: 今夜うちにいてくれ。

translation.pt-BR: Fica em casa hoje à noite.
translation.en: Be at home this evening.

items.label: connective particle て (links いる to the auxiliary くれ)
items.explanation: Puts いる in the て-form to take くれ, forming the request ～てくれ ('do this for me').

translation.pt-BR: Por hoje, vamos encerrar por aqui.
translation.en: That's enough for today.

items.label: connective particle (-te form)
items.explanation: て links the verb して to the auxiliary おく, forming 〜ておく ("leave it done in advance").

items.jp: 今日はこのくらいにしておこう。

translation.pt-BR: Por hoje, vamos parar por aqui.
translation.en: That's enough for today.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the verb し (する) to the auxiliary おく, forming the structure ～ておく ('do/leave in advance').

items.jp: 今日はいたずらばかりしているね。

translation.pt-BR: Você só está fazendo travessuras hoje, hein.
translation.en: You are being naughty today.

items.label: connective particle of the te-form
items.explanation: Forms the participle して, needed to link the verb to いる in the construction 〜ている (continuous action).

items.jp: 今日はここまでにしておこう。

translation.pt-BR: Vamos parar por aqui hoje.
translation.en: Let's call it a day today.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: 「て」 links し (する) to おく forming しておく ('to leave done in advance').

items.jp: 考えておくよ。

translation.pt-BR: Vou pensar a respeito, viu.
translation.en: I'll think about it.

items.label: connective particle (〜て form)
items.explanation: Links 考える to the auxiliary おく to form 〜ておく ('to get something done in advance').

items.jp: 見ておくべきだ。

translation.pt-BR: Você deveria dar uma olhada.
translation.en: You should try to see it.

items.label: connective particle (te-form)
items.explanation: Connects 見る to the auxiliary おく to form 見ておく ('to look ahead of time'). It is the て that allows the main verb to be chained to the preparatory auxiliary.

items.jp: 銀行へ行ってきたところです。

translation.pt-BR: Acabei de voltar do banco.
translation.en: I've been to the bank.

items.label: connective particle (links verbs)
items.explanation: て links 行く to くる, forming the sequence "go and come back"
tokens: verb (second in the sequence, indicates return)
formal noun of the ～たところ pattern (aspect)

items.jp: 近くでバスケットが作られている。

translation.pt-BR: Estão fazendo cestos ali perto.
translation.en: Baskets are being made nearby.

items.label: linking particle (te-form)
items.explanation: て joins the verb to the auxiliary いる, forming 〜ている ('to be doing/being done') to indicate a continuous action.

items.jp: 気に入ってくれるといいな。

translation.pt-BR: Tomara que você goste.
translation.en: I hope you'll like it.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 入っ (入る, in 気に入る) to the auxiliary くれる, forming 〜てくれる ('to like, for my benefit').

items.jp: 気にかけていただいてどうも。

translation.pt-BR: Obrigado por se preocupar comigo.
translation.en: I appreciate your concern.

items.explanation: て connects 気にかけ to the auxiliary verb いただく.
tokens: component of the idiom 気にかける

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links して to きて, chaining 'do' and 'come/return'.

items.jp: 帰りに買い物してきてくれる？

translation.pt-BR: Na volta, você faz umas compras pra mim?
translation.en: Would you mind picking up something on the way back?

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links きて to くれる, completing the favor structure 〜てくれる.

items.jp: 外はだんだん明るくなっていく。

translation.pt-BR: Lá fora vai ficando cada vez mais claro.
translation.en: It is getting lighter outside.

items.label: conjunctive particle (te-form)
items.explanation: て links the verb なる to the auxiliary いく, forming the construction 〜ていく which indicates a progressive change.

items.jp: 火にあたりながらすわっていた。

translation.pt-BR: Ficávamos sentados nos aquecendo perto do fogo.
translation.en: We sat over a fire.

items.label: connective particle て (links verb to auxiliary)
items.explanation: て turns すわる into すわって to link to the auxiliary いる, forming すわっている → in the past すわっていた ('was sitting'), expressing a state that lasted.

items.jp: 夏休みってすぐに終わってしまうんです。

translation.pt-BR: As férias de verão acabam num instante, sabe.
translation.en: How soon the summer holiday is over.

items.label: conjunctive particle (て-form)
items.explanation: て connects 終わる to しまう, forming the construction 〜てしまう.

items.jp: 何時に帰ってくるの。

translation.pt-BR: A que horas você volta?
translation.en: When will you come home?

items.label: connective particle て
items.explanation: Joins 帰る to the auxiliary くる in the construction 〜てくる.

items.jp: 何をやってみせてくれるのかしら？

translation.pt-BR: O que será que vão nos mostrar?
translation.en: I wonder what they have in store for us under the big top?

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links みせ (みせる) to the auxiliary くれる, forming 〜てくれる ('to do/show for me/us').

items.jp: 説明させてください。

translation.pt-BR: Deixe-me explicar.
translation.en: Let me explain.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the causative verb to ください, forming the request 'please do'.
tokens: verbal noun (head of 説明する)
support verb of the verbal noun

items.jp: 医者に見てもらうべきだと思う。

translation.pt-BR: Acho que você deveria ser examinado por um médico.
translation.en: I think you should see a doctor.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: Links 見 to the auxiliary もらう, forming the construction 〜てもらう (to receive the favor of someone doing something).
tokens: agent of the favor (the one who examines)

translation.pt-BR: Não precisa se dar ao trabalho de me ligar.
translation.en: Don't bother to call me.

items.explanation: て links かける to the auxiliary verb くださる, forming 'かけてくださる' (do the kindness of phoning).

translation.en: If I had known it, I would have gone there.

translation.pt-BR: Primeiro, deixe-me falar.
translation.en: Please let me speak first.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: The て links the causative verb 話させ to the request auxiliary ください, forming the pattern させてください.

items.jp: バスルームは今ふさがっている。

translation.pt-BR: O banheiro está ocupado agora.
translation.en: The bathroom is occupied now.

items.label: connective particle (〜て form)
items.explanation: て links ふさがっ to the auxiliary いる to form the continuous state ふさがっている ('is occupied').

translation.pt-BR: Já está na hora de o ônibus chegar.
translation.en: The bus is due here any time now.

items.explanation: て links 「やっ(て)」 to 「くる」, forming the compound verb やってくる ('to come along'), in which くる adds the nuance of movement toward the speaker.

translation.en: No man is so old he cannot learn.

items.explanation: て links とっ to いる forming the continuous aspect とっている ('to have aged').

verb of the phrase 年をとる
nominalizer (こと in ことはない)
negative predicate (ない of ことはない)

translation.pt-BR: Por mais que eu me esforce...
translation.en: No matter how hard I try...

items.label: て-form connective

translation.en: I steered clear of sensitive topics.

translation.pt-BR: Por favor, permaneça de pé.
translation.en: Please remain standing.

items.explanation: て links いる to 下さい, forming the polite request ～ていてください ('please keep...').

items.jp: ドアを開けたままにしておくな。

translation.pt-BR: Não deixe a porta aberta.

items.explanation: て links し to the auxiliary おく, forming しておく ('to leave done/as is').

translation.pt-BR: Vamos comer lá fora em vez de dentro da barraca.

translation.pt-BR: Você liga a TV pra mim?
translation.en: Will you turn on the TV?

items.explanation: Links the main verb つけて to the auxiliary くれる, forming 〜てくれる ('to do something for me').

translation.pt-BR: Já que você vai, aproveita e compra um pra mim também?
translation.en: Can you buy one for me as well?

items.label: て-form (links verbs)
items.explanation: Connects 買う to the auxiliary くる.

items.jp: ついでに私のも買ってきてくれますか。

translation.pt-BR: Já que você vai, aproveita e compra um pra mim também?
translation.en: Can you buy one for me as well?

items.label: て-form (links verbs)

translation.pt-BR: Vou dar uma passadinha no banco.

items.explanation: て links 寄っ to くる forming 寄ってくる (to stop by and come back).

translation.pt-BR: Que tal a gente dar uma passadinha naquela loja?
translation.en: How about dropping in at the shop?

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 寄っ to 行く forming 寄って行く (to stop by on the way).

items.jp: だんだん地金が出てきた。

translation.pt-BR: Aos poucos a verdadeira natureza dele foi aparecendo.
translation.en: His true colors are coming out.

items.label: connective particle (て)
items.explanation: Links 出る to the auxiliary verb くる, forming the compound 出てくる ('to gradually emerge').

translation.pt-BR: Deixe-me fazer uma pergunta, por favor.
translation.en: Let me ask you a question.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the causative させ to ください, forming the request させてください ('please let me ask (the question)').

items.jp: それをやってしまうまでここを出てはならん。

translation.pt-BR: Você não pode sair daqui até terminar de fazer isso.
translation.en: Don't leave here until you have done it.

items.label: connective particle て
items.explanation: て links やっ to the auxiliary しまう, forming the structure てしまう ('to do completely').

items.jp: それはもっていくつもりはなかったんだ。

translation.pt-BR: Eu não tinha a intenção de levar isso.
translation.en: I didn't mean to take that.

items.label: conjunctive particle (te-form)
items.explanation: て links もつ to the auxiliary いく, forming もっていく ('to take') (the construction 〜ていく of the lesson's target).

items.jp: その本には１ページおきに地図がのっている。

translation.pt-BR: Nesse livro, há um mapa a cada duas páginas.
translation.en: There are maps on alternate pages of the book.

items.label: links verb to auxiliary (て-form)
items.explanation: て connects のる to the auxiliary いる, forming のっている, the construction that expresses a continuous state ('to be laid out').

items.jp: その男は死にかけていた。

translation.pt-BR: Aquele homem estava à beira da morte.
translation.en: The man was on the brink of death.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 死にかけ to the auxiliary いる, forming the aspect ～ている (ongoing state).
tokens: auxiliary verb (aspect: on the verge of)

items.jp: その人は死にかけていた。

translation.pt-BR: Aquela pessoa estava morrendo.
translation.en: The man was dying.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て connects 死にかけ to the auxiliary いる, forming ～ている.
tokens: auxiliary verb (aspect: on the verge of)

items.jp: やってみるつもりだ。

translation.pt-BR: Pretendo experimentar fazer.
translation.en: I'm going to try.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: Links やっ to the auxiliary みる; it is the て that forms the construction 〜てみる (to try doing).

items.jp: その試験は２つのパートに分かれていた。

translation.pt-BR: A prova estava dividida em duas partes.
translation.en: The exam was divided into two parts.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 分かれる to the auxiliary いる, forming 〜ている (resulting state: 'to be divided').

items.jp: その犬は死にかけていた。

translation.pt-BR: Aquele cachorro estava morrendo.
translation.en: The dog was dying.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 死にかけ to the auxiliary いる, forming ～ている.
tokens: auxiliary verb (aspect: on the verge of)

items.jp: そして、そこでその男は入ってきました。

translation.pt-BR: E então, foi ali que aquele homem entrou.
translation.en: And so the man came in.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the verb 入る to the auxiliary くる, forming 入ってくる ('to come in [toward here]').

items.jp: ぜひ来てください。

translation.pt-BR: Venha, por favor, sem falta!
translation.en: Do come by all means.

items.label: conjunctive particle (〜て form)
items.explanation: て links 来 to ください, forming the polite request 来てください ('please come').

items.jp: ぜひやってみなさい。

translation.pt-BR: Experimente fazer, sem falta!
translation.en: Try by all means.

items.label: conjunctive particle (〜て form)
items.explanation: て links やっ to みる, forming the pattern 〜てみる ('to try doing').

items.jp: スリッパをはいてください。

translation.pt-BR: Por favor, calce os chinelos.
translation.en: Please put on your slippers.

items.label: connective particle of the te-form
items.explanation: て links the verb はく to ください, forming the polite request construction 'て-form + ください'.

items.jp: じゃあ、言わせてもらうけど。

translation.pt-BR: Então, deixa eu te dizer uma coisa.
translation.en: Let me tell you something.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: Links the causative 言わせて to the auxiliary もらう, creating 〜てもらう ('to receive the favor of'), here with the sense of 'let me / allow me'.
tokens: auxiliary verb of receiving a favor

items.jp: ご馳走が出るからおなかをすかせておきなさい。

translation.pt-BR: Vai ter um banquete, então guarde o apetite.
translation.en: Save your appetite for the big dinner.

items.label: links verb to the auxiliary (te-form)
items.explanation: て links すかせ to the auxiliary おく, forming ておく ('to leave done in advance').

items.jp: この国では、ラクダはなくてはならない。

translation.pt-BR: Neste país, os camelos são indispensáveis.
translation.en: They cannot do without camels in this country.

items.label: conjunctive particle (te-form)
items.explanation: Links なく ('there not being') to the rest; part of the expression 〜なくては ('without there being...').
tokens: auxiliary verb of the idiomatic expression

items.jp: この歌は私を楽しませてくれる。

translation.pt-BR: Essa música me deixa feliz.
translation.en: This song makes me happy.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 楽しませる to くれる, forming the favor structure 〜てくれる.

items.jp: このハンカチは紙でできているんです。

translation.pt-BR: Este lenço é feito de papel.
translation.en: This handkerchief is made of paper.

items.label: connective particle (て)
items.explanation: て links でき to いる to form the structure ている (できている), which expresses a state.

items.jp: このお金は夏の旅行にとっておこう。

translation.pt-BR: Vamos guardar este dinheiro para a viagem de verão.
translation.en: Let's put this money aside for our summer trip.

items.label: connective (て-form of the verb)
items.explanation: て links とる to the auxiliary おく, forming とっておく ('to set aside in advance').

items.jp: ウサギは耳が長くてしっぽが短い。

translation.pt-BR: O coelho tem orelhas compridas e rabo curto.
translation.en: A rabbit has long ears and a short tail.

items.label: connective て (links adjectives/clauses)
items.explanation: Attached to 長く, it chains the first characteristic to the second: 'long AND...'.

items.jp: カメラは持っていくのですか。

translation.pt-BR: Você vai levar a câmera?
translation.en: Are you bringing your camera?

items.label: conjunctive particle (te-form)
items.explanation: て links 持っ to いく forming the compound 〜ていく ('to take along / to go on doing').

items.jp: お母さんが何でもしてあげるから。

translation.pt-BR: A mamãe faz tudo por você, viu.
translation.en: I, your mother, will take care of everything for you.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the main verb し (する) to the auxiliary あげる, forming 〜てあげる ('to do for someone's benefit').
tokens: subject (the one who acts for the benefit)

items.jp: お父さんは今朝からずっと車を洗っている。

translation.pt-BR: Meu pai está lavando o carro sem parar desde hoje de manhã.
translation.en: My father has been washing his car since this morning.

items.label: connects the verb to the auxiliary いる
items.explanation: て links 洗う to いる to form 〜ている, expressing an ongoing action ('is washing').

items.jp: おじさんは今週うちにたいざいしている。

translation.pt-BR: Meu tio está hospedado na nossa casa esta semana.
translation.en: My uncle is staying with us this week.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 滞在し to the auxiliary いる, forming 〜ている ('to be staying / to be ongoing').
tokens: topic (head, with honorific suffix さん)
fragment of the noun 滞在 ('stay')
fragment of the noun 滞在 ('stay')

items.jp: いつ帰ってくるの？

translation.pt-BR: Quando você volta?
translation.en: When will you be back?

items.label: connective particle て
items.explanation: Links 帰る to the auxiliary verb くる to form the construction 〜てくる; it is the て that joins the two verbs.

items.jp: いくつか質問させてください。

translation.pt-BR: Deixe-me fazer algumas perguntas.
translation.en: Please permit me to ask you some questions.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: The て links the causative verb 質問させ to the request auxiliary ください, forming the pattern させてください.
tokens: object / verbal noun (root of 質問する)

items.jp: いいことを教えてやる。

translation.pt-BR: Vou te contar uma coisa boa.
translation.en: I'll tell you a secret.

items.label: conjunction linking the main verb to the auxiliary やる
items.explanation: This て is the て-form of 教えて, required by the target pattern 〜てやる: it chains the action 教える to the auxiliary やる, which signals that the speaker does this for the listener's benefit.
tokens: object (head of the phrase いいこと)

items.jp: あの子は一体どうなってしまうのかしら。

translation.pt-BR: O que será que vai ser daquela criança, afinal?
translation.en: I wonder what ever will become of the child.

items.label: conjunctive particle (て-form)
items.explanation: て connects なる to しまう, forming 〜てしまう.

items.jp: こんなに長い間待たせてすみません。

translation.pt-BR: Desculpe por tê-lo feito esperar por tanto tempo.
translation.en: I am sorry to have kept you waiting so long.

items.label: connective particle 〜て (links the verb to すみません)
items.explanation: The 〜て connects 待たせて ('having made you wait') to すみません, forming the target pattern 〜てすみません = 'sorry for (having done)...'. It is what articulates the apology around the described action.
tokens: main verb of the apology expression

items.jp: あそこで何をしていたの？

translation.pt-BR: O que você estava fazendo lá?
translation.en: What were you doing down there?

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the verb して to いる, forming the progressive aspect している/していた ('to be doing / was doing').

items.jp: ５時に駅で会うことになっている。

translation.pt-BR: Está combinado que vou encontrá-lo às cinco na estação.
translation.en: I am to meet him at five at the station.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links なっ (なる) to いる to form なっている (already established arrangement).
tokens: formal noun that nominalizes the preceding clause
verb of the ことになっている pattern

items.jp: ５０００円ばかりもっている。

translation.pt-BR: Tenho uns 5.000 ienes.
translation.en: I have about 5,000 yen.

items.label: connective particle of the te-form
items.explanation: Forms the participle もって, needed to link the verb to いる in the construction 〜ている (continuous state).

items.jp: ３日後に来てください。

translation.pt-BR: Volte daqui a três dias, por favor.
translation.en: Please come in three days.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て liga 来る ao que vem depois (くださる) e encadeia os dois dentro da mesma frase.

items.jp: １００万円持っているとしたらどうしますか。

translation.pt-BR: Se você tivesse um milhão de ienes, o que faria?
translation.en: Supposing you had one million yen, what would you do with it?

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て liga 持つ ao que vem depois (いる) e encadeia os dois dentro da mesma frase.

items.jp: 父は中学校で英語を教えています。

translation.pt-BR: Meu pai ensina inglês numa escola de ensino fundamental.
translation.en: My father teaches English at a middle school.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the verb 教え to the auxiliary いる, forming 〜ている, the structure that expresses ongoing or habitual action.

items.jp: コート着てくればよかった。

translation.pt-BR: Eu devia ter vindo de casaco.
translation.en: I should have worn a coat.

items.label: connective particle 〜て
items.explanation: Links 着る to the auxiliary verb くる, forming 着てくる ('to come dressed / to wear and bring'). It joins two actions into a single sequence.

items.jp: あなたがたにお話をしてあげる。

translation.pt-BR: Vou contar uma história para vocês.
translation.en: I'll tell you a story.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the main verb し (する) to the auxiliary あげる, forming the construction 〜てあげる ('to do for someone's benefit').

items.jp: どうやってやるのか教えて。

translation.pt-BR: Me ensina como se faz isso.
translation.en: Show me how to do it.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: This て is part of the phrase どうやって ('in what way/how'), linking やる to the adverb どう. It is not benefactive.
tokens: verb (て-form within the phrase どうやって)
main verb of the subordinate clause

items.jp: もう一度やってみる。

translation.pt-BR: Vou tentar mais uma vez.
translation.en: I will try again.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: Links やっ to the auxiliary みる, forming the construction 〜てみる (to try/attempt doing).

items.jp: 考えさせてください。

translation.pt-BR: Deixe-me pensar, por favor.
translation.en: Let me think, please.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the causative 考えさせ to ください, creating the request construction させてください ('please let me think').

items.jp: これは父に気に入ってもらう。

translation.pt-BR: Vou fazer com que meu pai goste disto.
translation.en: I'm going to make my dad like this.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the verb to the following element (another verb or auxiliary) in the て-form.
tokens: agent of the action (who will like it)
component of the verbal phrase 気に入る
auxiliary verb of receiving a favor

items.jp: 言ってみただけだよ！

translation.pt-BR: Eu só falei por falar!
translation.en: I'm just saying!

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the verb 言う to the auxiliary みる, forming 言ってみる ('to try saying').

items.jp: １１時になっているよ。

translation.pt-BR: Já são onze horas.
translation.en: It is already eleven.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links なって to いる forming 〜ている, which here expresses the resulting state ('it is already' 11 o'clock). It is the central connector of the target pattern.

items.jp: 私が話しているときは私を見て！

translation.pt-BR: Olhe para mim quando eu estiver falando!
translation.en: Look at me when I talk to you!

items.label: connective particle of the te-form
items.explanation: て links 話す to いる, forming the continuous construction 〜ている.
tokens: verb of the temporal clause (in 〜て form)
noun that forms the temporal clause

items.jp: もっとゆっくり話してください！

translation.pt-BR: Fale mais devagar, por favor!
translation.en: Speak more slowly, please!

items.label: connective particle -て
items.explanation: て turns 話す into 話して (て-form), required to form the request 〜てください.

items.jp: それで何をしようとしているの？

translation.pt-BR: Então, o que você está tentando fazer?
translation.en: And what are we going to do?

items.label: conjunctive particle (te-form)
items.explanation: て connects し (する) to いる to create the progressive aspect している ('be doing').
tokens: auxiliary verb (head of としている)

items.jp: 親切にしてやればつけあがる。

translation.pt-BR: Se você for gentil com ele, ele se aproveita.
translation.en: Give him an inch and he'll take a yard.

items.label: connective particle of the 〜て form
items.explanation: て links し (from する) to the auxiliary やる, forming the locution してやる ('to do a favor for someone').
tokens: adverbial auxiliary (に of 親切に)
benefactive auxiliary + verb of the conditional clause

items.jp: 毎日お昼ご飯を作っているよ。

translation.pt-BR: Eu faço o almoço todo dia, viu.
translation.en: I make lunch every day.

items.label: connective て
items.explanation: て links 作っ to the auxiliary いる, forming ～ている.

items.jp: 私の弟はテレビを見ている。

translation.pt-BR: Meu irmão mais novo está assistindo televisão.
translation.en: My little brother is watching TV.

items.label: connective て
items.explanation: て links 見 to the auxiliary いる, forming ～ている.
tokens: auxiliary verb of state/ongoing action (～ている)

items.jp: 犬は死にかけている。

translation.pt-BR: O cachorro está morrendo.
translation.en: The dog is dying.

items.label: connective particle て (links かける to いる)
items.explanation: Puts かける in the て-form to combine with いる, forming the continuous aspect 死にかけている ('is dying').

items.jp: トライしてみる。

translation.pt-BR: Vou tentar.
translation.en: I try.

items.label: connective particle て
items.explanation: Joins する to the auxiliary みる to form the construction 〜てみる ('to try/attempt').
tokens: noun (forms the compound verb with する)

items.jp: 「どいてください」「やんのか？あんちゃん」

translation.pt-BR: "Saia da frente, por favor." "Quer brigar, garotão?"
translation.en: "Please move aside." "Ya wanna make something of it, sonny?"

items.label: connective particle -て
items.explanation: て turns どく into どいて (て-form), required to form the request 〜てください.

items.jp: はきはきと意見を言ってください。

translation.pt-BR: Por favor, dê sua opinião de forma clara e direta.
translation.en: Please state your opinion crisply and clearly.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: Este て transforma 言う em 言って e se liga a ください, formando o pedido 言ってください ('diga, por favor').

items.jp: 今までいったい何をしていたんだ！

translation.pt-BR: Afinal, o que você esteve fazendo até agora?!
translation.en: What have you been getting up to till now?!

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the verb する to the auxiliary いる, creating the continuous form していた.

items.jp: 外が暗くなってきた。

translation.pt-BR: Está ficando escuro lá fora.
translation.en: It's getting darker outside now.

items.label: connective particle (te-form)
items.explanation: て links なっ to the auxiliary きた, forming the 〜てくる pattern of gradual change.

items.jp: いいか、よく聞いてくれ！

translation.pt-BR: Escuta bem, presta atenção!
translation.en: Alright! Listen up and listen well!

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 聞く to the auxiliary くれ, forming 聞いてくれ (listen for me).

items.jp: 二本の道はそこでクロスしている。

translation.pt-BR: As duas estradas se cruzam ali.
translation.en: The two roads cross there.

items.label: connective particle of the te-form
items.explanation: て links クロスする to いる, forming the 〜ている construction that here expresses state.
tokens: nominal stem of the compound verb (part of する)

items.jp: 男の子はたらいの中でジャブジャブ水をはねかしていた。

translation.pt-BR: O menino ficava espalhando água pra todo lado dentro da bacia.
translation.en: The boy splashed about in the tub.

items.label: conjunctive particle (te-form)
items.explanation: て links the verb はねかし to the auxiliary いる, forming 〜ている/〜ていた (action in progress in the past).

translation.pt-BR: Eu também vou tentar fazer isso por conta própria.
translation.en: I'll do it by myself too.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links やっ to みます, forming the structure 〜てみる ('to do and see/try'). It connects the main verb to the auxiliary of attempt.
tokens: manner adverb (base of 自分でも)

items.jp: ほらマンゴーがたくさんなっているよ。

translation.pt-BR: Olha, a árvore está cheia de manga!
translation.en: Look at all the mangoes growing on that tree.

items.label: conjunctive particle (te-form)
items.explanation: て links the verb なる to the auxiliary いる to form ている, which expresses the continuous aspect/resulting state.

items.jp: つながれているという思いがつのった。

translation.pt-BR: Cresceu em mim o sentimento de estar preso.
translation.en: Thoughts of being trapped grew stronger.

translation.en: Please drive off as soon as your child has left the car.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the verb 出す to ください, forming the polite request 〜てください.

translation.pt-BR: Os que estavam de pé eram todos homens.
translation.en: Those standing were all men.

items.explanation: て links 立つ to the auxiliary いる, forming the continuous/stative form 立っている ('be standing').

items.explanation: て links 立っ to the auxiliary いる, forming 立っている.

translation.en: He came even though I told him not to.

items.explanation: て links やっ (from やる) to きた, forming the compound verb やってくる ('to come, to arrive').
tokens: main verb (part of やってくる)
main verb (part of やってくる)

translation.pt-BR: Eu ficaria muito feliz se você viesse.
translation.en: I'd be very glad if you'd come.

items.label: connective particle of the 〜て form

tokens: honorific auxiliary + verb of the conditional clause

translation.en: Evening was drawing near.

items.explanation: て links 近づく to the auxiliary いる; it is the link that allows the continuous construction 〜ていた.

translation.pt-BR: Estava dizendo que vai chover a partir do fim da tarde, viu.

items.explanation: て links いう to the auxiliary いる to form the continuous past 〜ていた.

translation.pt-BR: Eu conheço um bom lugar para o jantar, viu?
translation.en: I know a good place for dinner.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て joins 知っ to いる to form 知っている, expressing the continuous state of 'knowing'.
tokens: object (head of the phrase いいところ)

items.explanation: て links なっ (なる) to いる to form なっている (determined state).
tokens: formal noun that nominalizes the preceding clause
verb of the ことになっている pattern

translation.en: Day is breaking.

items.explanation: て links the verb 着る to the auxiliary いる to form the continuous/habitual aspect 着ている.

items.explanation: て connects the verb 持つ to the auxiliary いる to form 持っている → 持っていた, expressing a continuous state in the past ('had/possessed').

items.explanation: て links やっ to いる to form the 〜ている construction, which expresses a state/continuous action.

items.explanation: て links ついて to くる, forming the compound ついてくる ('to come along/accompanying').

items.explanation: て links 帰る to the auxiliary verb くる, forming 帰ってくる ('to come back / to arrive here').

items.explanation: て links the verb to the following element (another verb or auxiliary) in the て-form.

items.explanation: て links the verb し to the auxiliary いる, forming the continuous/aspectual form している (here in the past していた).

items.explanation: this て links 買ってくる to the adjective ほしい, creating the target construction 〜てほしい ('to want someone to do').

items.explanation: Joins 試す to みる forming 〜てみる ('to try testing').

items.explanation: Links 行く to the auxiliary くる, forming 〜てくる ('to go and come back here').

items.explanation: て links 使っ to the auxiliary しまう, forming 使ってしまう ('to spend completely').

items.explanation: て links 言う to the auxiliary みる, forming てみる ('to try doing').
